messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Datadog ingestion delays detected for US region. Metrics/logs/traces delayed ~15-40m; ingestion API returning 502 intermittently. Auto-ticket DD-674999 opened.
oncall-sre: Confirmed. Datadog panels frozen; inference-5xx shows spike but cut off ~18m ago. We have customer 503 reports. Starting fallback visibility plan now. :rotating_light:
Maya: Quick plan: 1) enable per-node exporter and push to Prometheus pushgateway 2) mirror logs to gs://redwood-incident-logs/1825000000 3) route critical alerts to PagerDuty SMS. I'll run steps 1 & 2.
Jun: Commands I'm running now:
```
# deploy pushgateway
kubectl -n monitoring apply -f k8s/pushgateway-deploy.yaml
# enable local metrics export on inference pods
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/inference-api METRICS_FALLBACK=pushgateway
# mirror logs to GCS
kubectl -n infra exec deploy/log-forwarder -- /bin/sh -c "forward-logs --dest gs://redwood-incident-logs/1825000000 --compress"
```
Felix: I started a lightweight aggregator on a small job to compute rolling error rate from the GCS logs and push the result to Prometheus as a gauge. Running:
```
./tools/err_agg --src gs://redwood-incident-logs/1825000000 --window 60 --prom-url http://pushgateway.monitoring.svc:9091
```
ops-support: CS: two enterprise tenants reported degraded inference; drafting customer note. Suggest we avoid deep technical details — emphasize mitigations and monitoring.
ops-support: customer note draft:
```
We're experiencing degraded monitoring due to a third-party provider. Our engineers have enabled alternate telemetry and increased logging to investigate and mitigate. We'll provide updates every 30 minutes and will notify if customer action is required.
```
oncall-sre: Handoff plan: I'm staying 20m to validate pushgateway + GCS uploads, then hand to @sre-rotation. Checklist:
- confirm pushgateway is receiving apps metrics (https://prom.monitor/internal/targets)
- verify logs show up in GCS (gsutil ls gs://redwood-incident-logs/1825000000)
- ensure PagerDuty escalation on for inference-critical alert
sre-rotation: taking handoff. Immediate checklist:
1) confirm PagerDuty SMS escalation and test delivery
2) increase trace sampling to 100% for 10m to capture failing traces
3) if error_rate > 5% for 2 consecutive 5m windows, coordinate a rollback of the canary
status-bot: STATUS PAGE POSTED: "Partial observability - Datadog ingestion delays affecting metrics/logs (US region). Fallback telemetry enabled. Updates every 30 minutes." https://status.redwood-inference.com/incidents/2026-03-15
Jun: Datadog support acknowledged DD-674999: ingestion backlog due to upstream queue issue. They've started backfill but ETA unclear. Asked them for backlog size and earliest missing timestamp.
Maya: GCS uploads in progress, first files appear. Pushgateway targets show several inference instances posting metrics. Aggregator is computing error-rate and pushing to Prometheus.
Felix: Aggregator early output:
```
2026-03-15T18:12:00Z,model_variant=gamma-1,error_rate=0.075
2026-03-15T18:13:00Z,model_variant=gamma-1,error_rate=0.062
```
sre-rotation: Verified PagerDuty SMS tests; trace sampling increased. Aggregator metrics match app logs (gamma-1 high). I'll coordinate rollback if threshold holds.
ops-support: Customer update sent to impacted tenants; monitoring CS tickets for replies. No escalations so far.
oncall-sre: handing off to @sre-rotation now. If Datadog doesn't recover in 45m escalate to exec oncall to discuss paid backup ingestion path (costly) and get approval.
Jun: Datadog just replied: backfill started; estimated catch-up in ~40-60m. They offered to export raw events if needed.
status-bot: AUTOMATED: Postmortem ticket INC-2026-182500 created (observability blindspot due to Datadog ingestion delay). Please append timeline and remediation notes.
Felix: Started a temporary Grafana dashboard pointing at Prometheus pushgateway and the aggregator gauge. Sharing link in ops channel. Numbers show gamma-1 ~6.5% 5xx.
sre-rotation: executed manual rollback of gamma-1 canary at T+16m; fallback metrics show error_rate dropping to ~0.9% after ~5m. Keeping fallbacks active for 1 hour post-recovery.
ops-support: Sent customer follow-up noting rollback and mitigations. No new customer escalations.
Maya: Action items for postmortem: 1) add automated fallback orchestration to runbook (pushgateway + GCS sink + aggregator + Grafana template) 2) add vendor escalation checklist asking for raw event export and backlog size.
sre-rotation: Standing by for 30m. If Datadog catches up earlier we'll flip alerts back and keep fallback read-only for 2 hours. If not, we will schedule a follow-up incident review for automation and cost decisions. :memo:"
